description: A new steel footbridge over a deep river gorge at sunrise. The two halves of the bridge meet in the middle, and a young woman in a white hard hat, orange high-visibility jacket and safety harness kneels on the steel grating, tightening the bolts on the plate that joins them with a big wrench. Across the gap a worker welds the seam in a shower of sparks. She then sits up and raises her fist with a shout, and workers in hard hats cheer on both sides. Two tall cranes stand on the cliffs and a safety net hangs below.

taps.target: the worker in the dark helmet
